_comment: Config for scripts/import_attacks.py (tasks.md T013b). Lists datasets and the item IDs to import. Contains NO prompt text: the script downloads each dataset and copies the named items. Fill 'sources' with 16-24 items total, at least 3 per family, from redistributable sources (garak, JailbreakBench, PyRIT, ...).

_entry_format.name: human-readable source name, recorded as each prompt's 'source'
_entry_format.url: URL the script downloads the dataset from
_entry_format.source_url: citation URL, recorded as each prompt's 'source_url'
_entry_format.licence: SPDX-style id; must permit redistribution (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC0-1.0, BSD, ISC); non-commercial (NC), no-derivatives (ND), proprietary or unknown are refused
_entry_format.format: 'jsonl' (one JSON object per line) or 'json' (a list of objects)
_entry_format.family: one of: direct_injection, system_prompt_leak, tool_exfiltration, indirect_injection
_entry_format.id_field: the field in the dataset that identifies an item
_entry_format.text_field: the field holding the prompt text
_entry_format.title_field: optional field for a title; null for a neutral generated title
items: the item IDs to take from this dataset
